_comment: Machine-readable mirror of ELEMENT_TYPES (ElementTypesJs.html), defaultCanvasSettings/defaultNavStyle (SlideManagerJs.html / NavBarJs.html). If those source files change, update this file to match — prompt.md's data model section is written to stay consistent with this.

id.notes: Unique per element. Reusing the SAME id for an element on a different slide is how cross-slide 'linking' (animated continuity) works — it is not an error, it's the core mechanic of this tool.

name.notes: Layer-panel display label only. Purely cosmetic, doesn't affect rendering.

x.notes: Meaning depends on type — see per-type notes. For text/rect/icon this is the left edge of the bounding box. For arrow this is the TAIL (start point), not a bounding-box corner.

y.notes: Same caveat as x — top edge for text/rect/icon, tail point for arrow.

width.notes: For text and arrow this is recomputed by the app on load/edit (text: from wrapping; arrow: from length+angle) — set a reasonable value but don't rely on it being authoritative for those two types.

content.notes: Plain text only — no inline bold/italic/links. Use literal \n for explicit line breaks; long lines auto word-wrap to width. A single word longer than the box overflows rather than breaking mid-word.

fontWeight.notes: String, not number, even though it looks numeric.

lineHeight.notes: Multiplier of fontSize, not a pixel value.

text.notes: height is auto-recalculated from wrapped line count on load — don't worry about getting it exactly right.

rect.notes: Each corner radius is clamped at render time to min(width,height)/2, so opposite corners never overlap. No stroke/border field exists — fill only.

arrow.notes: x,y is the arrow's TAIL point, not a bounding-box corner — the arrowhead lands at (x + length*sin(angle), y - length*cos(angle)). width/height are derived, ignore them when placing an arrow.

iconName.notes: CLOSED SET. Any other value silently falls back to 'star' — do not invent icon names.

icon.notes: width/height set the icon's square render size directly (unlike text/arrow, these ARE authoritative here).

width.notes: Artboard pixel width. All element x/y/width/height are in this same coordinate space, origin top-left, y increases downward.

snapToGrid.notes: Authoring-only convenience, has no effect on rendering/export — safe to leave false.

buttonBottomColor.notes: The active button's 3D-style bottom border color.

canvasSettings.notes: If `nav` is omitted entirely, defaults are used automatically. If canvasSettings itself is provided but missing individual keys (other than nav), those keys end up undefined rather than defaulted — always emit the full object.

id.notes: Any unique string, e.g. 'slide-1'. Must be unique across the whole project's slides.

name.notes: Shown as the nav bar button label learners click — keep it short, it doesn't wrap.

elements.notes: Array order = visual stacking order, first = bottom of stack.

topLevelState.slides: array of slide objects, in playback order
